lessons_used: Sign-in & account: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in post-waiting hurt, while sync hints and notices showed no clear effect.

Path selection: Headline clarity updates, spotlight layouts, and story stage visual redesigns won; checklist layouts and story scroll redesigns hurt, while value refreshes and copy simplifications showed no clear effect.

Waiting room: Interactive waiting rooms, readiness/visibility status checks, and spawn location hints won; 3D trackers, completion timers, progress indicators, and sound notifications showed no clear effect.

Adoption flow: Split upload companion previews paired with photo quality guides won; compact grids, guidelines banners, stamp redesigns, and multi-step inspection or fallback flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews showed no clear effect.

Finish & placement: Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome stage redesigns and retrieval callouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions accuracy: Predictions underpredicted counter-intuitive flow wins (such as placement verification screens and interactive spawn flows) and overpredicted outcomes on severe failures (such as stamp redesigns, direct controls guides, and guided spawn stages).

candidates.title: Post-Placement Account Binding Sequence
candidates.change: Reorder the sign-in step to take place right after desktop onboarding completion, ensuring users see their pet running on their desktop first before securing account data.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again. Securing account state after pet creation ensures session safety.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet Cloud Backup
sign_in.body: Sign in now to save your pet companion and enable seamless syncing across devices.

guard.reason: home_intro must come after every existing screen, sign_in included

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Companion Customization Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout with pet preview and name verification components to make pet adoption feel official.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate at 68.9% with mean time over 1000s. Enhancing adoption confirmation increases user commitment.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate

lessons_next: Sign-in & account: Post-adoption sign-in timing, account recovery copy, and multi-device sync banners won; moving sign-in post-waiting hurt, while account sync hints and safety notices showed no clear effect.

Waiting room: Interactive waiting rooms, desktop visibility/readiness status checks, and spawn location hints won; progress trackers, timers, sound notifications, and compatibility screens showed no clear effect.

Adoption flow: Split photo upload previews with quality guides won; compact grids, guidelines banners, stamp redesigns, and fallback or multi-step inspection flows hurt, while pre-adoption reviews, incentives, and layout customizations showed no clear effect.

Finish & placement: Interactive spawn placement flows, desktop placement verification screens, and system tray location tips won; direct controls guides, guided spawn stages, and first interaction tips hurt, while welcome redesigns, docking hints, and retrieval callouts showed no clear effect.
